nodes.label: Strict Origin Referrer Policy
nodes.rationale: Restricts Referer header to origin-only on cross-origin navigation so sensitive tokens in query parameters are not leaked to third-party servers.

nodes.label: React Compiler
nodes.rationale: React Compiler is not enabled in this template due to its impact on dev and build performance.

nodes.label: AMS Stacked Layout (Current)
nodes.rationale: Current design stacks AMS units vertically: 4 AMS rows + 1 HT row = 5 rows in AMS section.

nodes.label: AMS 2-Column Grid Layout (New)
nodes.rationale: New design uses a 2-column grid for up to 4x AMS units, with a 4-across row for HT and External spools, reducing vertical space to 3 rows total.

nodes.label: Bambuddy Dark Theme Design Tokens
nodes.rationale: CSS custom properties match actual Bambuddy dark theme, including bambu-green (#00ae42) as primary brand color and humidity indicator colors (good/fair/bad).

nodes.label: Bambu Lab 3D Printer (H2D)
nodes.rationale: Target hardware for monitoring: Bambu Lab H2D printer with dual nozzle (0.4mm) support and AMS filament management system.
